name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: shadcn's sidebar as the dashboard's: on the canvas, 212px, 32px rows with 16px icons, the current page on the neutral gray wash, outlined group tags, a white drawer on phones.
usage: The main navigation of an app. Wrap the page in SidebarProvider, put Sidebar and SidebarInset side by side, the workspace and search in SidebarHeader, pages in SidebarGroup with SidebarMenuButton (isActive on the current page), and Help, Documentation and the account in SidebarFooter. Use collapsible icon for a rail that narrows to its icons. For the dashboard's exact shell with its centered list, use the product app-sidebar.
avoid: Animating the current row as it changes
More than about ten top-level rows
Icons on some rows and not others

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
